top_signals.title: OPEC Output Rose in July Led by Gulf Nations, Survey Shows
top_signals.summary: OPEC’s crude oil production recouped some more of its wartime losses last month with gains in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Iraq, though opaque shipping data complicated the process of tracking the group’s output, a Bloomberg survey showed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Palantir jumps 30% on 'otherworldly' commercial revenue — here's what's driving the demand
top_signals.summary: "Our customers have declined to become vassal states of the language labs," Palantir's co-founder and CEO Alex Karp said after blowout second-quarter earnings.
